evals.name: theming-doc-to-training-deck
evals.expected_output: A valid c-deck deck JSON (TitleSlide + 2-3 content slides) covering: what theming is for, the preset vs overrides vs preset+overrides usage patterns, the list of overridable tokens, and the known chrome limitation as a callout. All component types must exist in src/SlideTemplates.jsx.
assertions: valid_json: deck.json parses as valid JSON
slide_count_in_range: top-level slides array has 3-5 entries
opens_with_title_slide: slides[0].type === "TitleSlide"
all_types_recognized: scripts/validate_deck.js exits 0 against this deck
mentions_chrome_limitation: deck text contains the known-limitation content (glow/stripe/tint/"not.*theme-aware")
covers_override_tokens: deck text mentions at least 5 of the 15 named override tokens
no_verbatim_dump: content is restructured into the deck's own slide/headline language, not the README section pasted wholesale onto one slide (qualitative)

evals.name: pricing-pitch-with-table-and-rollout
evals.prompt: We're pitching a pricing change to the team. Quick context: today everyone gets a per-seat license at $120/seat/month regardless of usage. Heavy users (background agents, batch jobs) cost way more in actual API spend than light users (occasional chat). We want to move to a shared token pool billed at $0.002/1k tokens with per-team soft caps. For an 8-seat team this would drop monthly cost from $960 to about $580 based on last quarter's usage. Risk: one noisy team could drain the pool fast, so we're adding soft caps + alerts. Rollout would be pilot (2 teams, 2 weeks) -> expand (all teams, 2 weeks) -> operate (monthly review). Can you build me a deck.json out of this for our c-deck presenter? I want a title slide, then the problem, the cost comparison, the risk, and the rollout plan.
evals.expected_output: A valid c-deck deck JSON with a TitleSlide plus slides for: the per-seat problem, a cost comparison (likely DataTable, $960 vs $580), the pool-drain risk (likely NoteBlock), and the 3-stage rollout (likely Stages/StageCard with pilot/expand/operate). All component types valid against SlideTemplates.jsx.
assertions: valid_json: deck.json parses as valid JSON
slide_count_in_range: top-level slides array has 4-6 entries
opens_with_title_slide: slides[0].type === "TitleSlide"
all_types_recognized: scripts/validate_deck.js exits 0 against this deck
has_both_cost_figures: deck text contains both "$960" and "$580"
has_all_rollout_stages: deck text mentions pilot, expand, and operate (case-insensitive)
one_idea_per_slide: problem/cost/risk/rollout land on distinct slides rather than collapsed onto fewer slides than requested (qualitative)

evals.name: messy-retro-notes-to-allhands-deck
evals.prompt:
ok so notes from the retro yesterday, kind of a mess, can u make this into slides for the all-hands:

- launched the new onboarding flow last sprint
- signup completion went from 41% to 63% !!
- biggest win was removing the credit card step up front
- still seeing drop off on the email verification step, like 15% bounce there
- support tickets about onboarding down 30%
- next sprint: fix email verif (send reminder after 10 min), then look at mobile onboarding which we havent touched at all
- someone asked about A/B testing the new flow vs old - not done yet, maybe next quarter

needs to go out before the all hands tomorrow at 2pm, output as json please
evals.expected_output: A valid c-deck deck JSON turning unstructured bullet notes into a coherent narrative: title, the result (41%->63%, likely StatRow/Stat), what worked, what's still broken (email verification bounce), and next steps (likely TickList or StageCard). Should not just dump the bullets verbatim onto one slide.
assertions: valid_json: deck.json parses as valid JSON
slide_count_in_range: top-level slides array has 3-6 entries
opens_with_title_slide: slides[0].type === "TitleSlide"
all_types_recognized: scripts/validate_deck.js exits 0 against this deck
has_key_metric: deck text contains both "41%" and "63%"
no_single_bullet_dump: the 7 source bullets are not all crammed as literal list items onto one single slide's content array (qualitative + structural)
narrative_restructuring: notes/headlines reframe the retro bullets into a deck narrative rather than copy-pasting them verbatim (qualitative)
